name: confer
description: Claude and Codex challenge each other's analysis, requirements, designs, code reviews, and answers to a question until they agree.

worktree.title: Review worktree
worktree.description: Run Codex in a detached worktree where the OS does not enforce read-only.

claudeRoutineModel.title: Claude routine model
claudeRoutineModel.description: The Claude model of the routine tier: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, or fable) or a model id. At fable, Confer runs Opus one effort level up where the account is not served Fable, or when the conductor reports 80% or more of the weekly Fable limit used.

claudeRoutineEffort.title: Claude routine effort
claudeRoutineEffort.description: The Claude effort of the routine tier.
